page.layout: One page of text, one justified block of Syriac, 19 lines, with no margin notes. Below the text, at the left, a short line that may be a catchword. Printed page number 647 at the head right. Gathering signature "Ss 4" at the foot.
page.notes: The script is Syriac, not Latin, Greek or Hebrew. I could not read its letters at this scan resolution, so every line is marked illegible, and the letter counts are estimates. Paragraph divisions are also uncertain: the indents are hard to see. The line count is approximate. The short line at the lower left is either a catchword or a fragment of the last line; I have put it in the catchword position but cannot confirm it. A higher-resolution scan, or a transcription of the Syriac by a reader of the language, would allow a proper transcription.
